义项: 名词 极小的斑点、一点点（a speck of dust / a rippling speck）
名词 (引申义) 真题 a rippling speck against the sky 以「天空中一个颤动的小点」写风筝升得极高

例句.英文: He watches his father raise a kite within minutes into the wind, so high that Gogol must tip his head back in order to see, a rippling speck against the sky.
例句.原书高亮: a rippling speck against the sky.
例句.中文: 他看着父亲几分钟内就把风筝放上风里，高得果戈理必须仰起头才看得见——那只是衬在天空上、微微颤动的一个小点。

例句.英文: He watches his father lift a kite within minutes into the wind, so high that Arun must tip his head back in order to see, a fluttering speck against the sky.

义项: 名词 易感性；易受影响的性质（susceptibility to X）
名词 （对疾病的）易感性
搭配说明: susceptible — adj. 易受影响的（susceptible to）
susceptibility vs vulnerability — vulnerability 强调「易受伤害」，susceptibility 强调「易被影响」

例句.英文: These animals are thought to be especially vulnerable to ocean acidification due to calcium carbonate's susceptibility to dissolution at lower pH values.
例句.中文: 这些动物被认为对海洋酸化尤为脆弱，因为碳酸钙在 pH 值较低时易于溶解。

例句.英文: Students in a biology class investigated why individual house mice (Mus musculus) can differ from one another in their susceptibility to cataracts in old age.
例句.中文: 一个生物课上的学生小组研究了为什么个别小家鼠（Mus musculus）年老时患白内障的易感性各不相同。

义项: 名词 暴风雨；狂风暴雨（文学 / 古语色彩，现代英语多用 storm）
名词 (引申义) 骚动；风潮（a tempest of protest）
搭配说明: tempestuous — adj. 暴风雨般的；动荡激烈的
The Tempest — 《暴风雨》——莎士比亚剧作，真题文本常客

例句.英文: Several games, including the 1981game Tempest, are playable at the museum, but other games, including the 2003 game Eve Online, are shown only in video footage because they are too complex to exhibit in a playable form.
例句.中文: 包括 1981 年的游戏《Tempest》在内的几款游戏可在馆内试玩，但另一些游戏（如 2003 年的《Eve Online》）只能以视频形式展示——它们太过复杂，无法以可玩的形式展出。

例句.英文: The poem is a dedication to Puerto Cabello, a town on the northern coast of Venezuela. And while outside the tempest is raving o’er the ocean,And the ship is madly driving on some lone and desert shore;Thy warm and land-locked waters swell with an easy motion,And gently glides the light pirogue [canoe] at dipping of the oar.
例句.中文: 这首诗是献给委内瑞拉北部海岸小镇波多卡贝洛的颂歌。任凭外面风暴在海上狂啸，任凭船儿疯狂地漂向孤寂荒凉的海岸；你温暖而闭锁的港湾水面轻柔起伏，轻舟在船桨起落间缓缓滑行。

义项: 形容词 （论点、立场）站得住脚的；可维持的（tenable position / assumption）
形容词 (引申义) （职位、阵地）可保持的
搭配说明: tenability / tenure — n. 可维持性 / n. 任期；终身教职——同根 ten-（持有）
tenable ≠ untenable — 反义：untenable 站不住脚的
defensible / viable — adj. 可辩护的 / adj. 可行的——近义

例句.英文: However, literary-critical methodologies in particular make assumptions about authorial control that to be tenable must be restricted to forms like novels, poems, and plays.
例句.原书高亮: that to be tenable must be restricted to forms like novels
例句.中文: 然而，尤其是文学批评方法，其对作者控制权所作的假定若要站得住脚，就必须被限定在小说、诗歌、戏剧这类形式之内。

例句.英文: Luu et al. point out, the singular nature of impact ejection makes it untenable as an account of multiple loss episodes of similar duration over several years.
例句.中文: Luu 等人指出，撞击喷出物的奇异性，使其无法解释数年间多次时长相近的损失事件。

义项: 形容词 文本的；与文本有关的（textual evidence / analysis / variant）
[构词] text（编织→文本）+ -ual
[辨析] textual「文本的」≠ texture「质地；纹理」——形近异义
搭配说明: text — n. 文本（真题题干高频：Text 1 / Text 2）
context / subtext — n. 语境 / 潜台词——同根，学术阅读常客

例句.英文: The many editions of James Joyce's 1922 novel Ulysses are not textually identical, and scholars debate which versions reflect Joyce's authorial intent.
例句.中文: 《尤利西斯》1922年以来的众多版本在文本上并不完全一致，学者们仍在争论哪些版本才体现了乔伊斯的作者原意。

例句.英文: The student wants to include two pieces of textual evidence that demonstrate people reacting in similar ways to this sensibility of Owen's.
例句.中文: 该学生想引用两处文本证据，证明人们对欧文这种气质的反应如出一辙。

义项: 动词 发生；（事情）被人知晓、透露（It transpired that…：后来才知道…）
动词 （植物）蒸腾；散发（水汽）——科技类文章的第二义
动词 transpire「发生」≠ inspire / aspire / conspire，词根 spir-（呼吸）易混
搭配说明: transpiration — n. 蒸腾（作用）
occur / come to light — 近义：发生 / 曝光

例句.英文: … but now the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside any one fence was something to be repudiated with contempt …
例句.原书高亮: should be transpiring inside any one fence
例句.中文: 那片地方原本看起来很大，可如今一想到所有这些狂暴与骚动竟然都发生在同一道栅栏之内，就让人不由得要以轻蔑的态度加以否定，如同看待一场镜中戏法。

义项: 动词 急速打转、回旋（whipped and whirled about）
名词 (引申义) 一阵忙乱（a whirl of activity）；give it a whirl 试一试

例句.英文: In rural Alabama, a man referred to as the stranger is walking among a group of untamed calico (spotted) horses that he has penned in a lot. [The horses] whipped and whirled about the lot like dizzy fish in a bowl.
例句.原书高亮: whipped and whirled about the lot
例句.中文: 在密西西比乡间，一个被称作「陌生人」的男子正走在一群被他圈在围栏里的野性花斑马之间——[马群]像碗里晕头转向的鱼一样，在圈里甩尾打转。

义项: 副词 极为（糟糕地）；可怜地（woefully inadequate / little / unaware）——书面强调副词，带「令人遗憾」色彩
[构词] woe（悲哀）+ -ful + -ly
搭配说明: woeful — adj. 糟糕的；悲哀的
sadly / deplorably — 近义副词：令人遗憾地

例句.英文: Meanwhile, the work of Dorothy Parker, who relied on conventional poetic forms associated with previous literary periods, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.
例句.原书高亮: attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism
例句.中文: 与此同时，多萝西·帕克的作品因沿用与先前文学时期相关的传统诗体，只吸引到现代主义研究者少得可怜的关注。

例句.英文: Meanwhile, John Steinbeck's Of Mice and Men, whose coherent, linear narrative structure recalls the fiction of previous centuries, attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism.Text 2Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.
例句.原书高亮: attracts woefully little attention from scholars of modernism
例句.中文: 与此同时，约翰·斯坦贝克的《人鼠之间》——其连贯的线性叙事结构令人想起前几个世纪的小说——却几乎得不到现代主义学者的关注。——远读，即对海量数字化文本的计算机辅助定量分析，能够揭示此前无人察觉的风格要素，尽管这些要素为现代主义时期的众多文本所共有。

义项: 动词 使更突出、更明显（accentuate the presence of X）
[构词] accent n. 重音 → accentuate v.；与 emphasize 同义但更偏「通过对比 / 反复呈现来凸显」

例句.英文: The camera’s presence is continually accentuated by showing the operator positioning it, for example, placing it atop a steel structure, where he then adjusts the camera to capture a view of traffic passing underneath, to which the film cuts immediately after.
例句.原书高亮: is continually accentuated by showing the
例句.中文: 影片不断通过展示操作员架设机器的过程来凸显摄影机的存在，例如把它架在一座钢构上、再调整机位以拍到下方车流，随后镜头立刻切到那个画面。

义项: 动词 be acquainted with 熟悉、了解（某人 / 某物）
动词 acquaint oneself with 主动去了解；n. acquaintance 熟人 / 略知，别与 acquire 混淆

例句.英文: The untaught peasant beheld the elements around him and was acquainted with their practical uses.
例句.原书高亮: and was acquainted with their practical
例句.中文: 维克多·弗兰肯斯坦正在叙述这段文字，他描述了自己开始研究自然界时科学知识的状况：未受教育的农人观察周身万物，只熟悉它们的实际用途。

义项: 名词 实际存在、真实性（historical actuality 历史真实性）
[辨析] in actuality = in fact（书面副词短语）；与 potentiality（可能性）相对
搭配说明: actualize — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 11 次；已并入本词条

例句.英文: However, some differentiate between members of the dynasty like Wladyslaw I Herman, who ruled as duke from 1079 to 1102 CE, and less well-documented figures like Lestek, who is said to have ruled in the 9th and 10th centuries but whose historical actuality is disputed.
例句.中文: 不过，也有人把王朝中像 1079 至 1102 年在位的公爵瓦迪斯瓦夫一世这类有明确记载者，与莱斯特克这类据称在 9、10 世纪统治却记载寥寥、其历史真实性仍受质疑的人物区分开来。

义项: 形容词 富裕的；充裕的（the affluent 作名词：富裕阶层）
[构词] ad-（向）+ flu（流）→ 流向你 → 富足
搭配说明: affluence — n. 富裕
fluent / fluid — adj. 流利的 / 流动的——同根 flu-（流）

例句.英文: The affluent accepted fines as merely a tax on privilege, even as the amounts increased with frequent revisions to the laws.
例句.原书高亮: The affluent accepted fines as merely a tax on privilege
例句.中文: 富裕阶层把罚款仅仅当作对特权征收的一项税，即便随着法律频繁修订，罚金数额也水涨船高。

例句.英文: Reexamining these data, Gregory Clark notes that while inventories from the period appear consistent with the consumer-revolution argument, the proportion of the population whose wills included such documentation decreased considerably between 1600 and 1750, with this documentation increasingly representing more affluent individuals.
例句.中文: 重新审视这些数据时，Gregory Clark 指出：虽然该时期的财产清单看似支持「消费革命」的论点，但遗嘱中含此类记录的人口比例在 1600 至 1750 年间大幅下降，这类记录越来越多地只代表更富裕的人群。

义项: 名词 聚集（体）；集聚（agglomeration economies：集聚经济）
名词 （城市）连片扩张区；建成区——城市研究术语
搭配说明: agglomerate — v. 聚集 / n. 集合体
aggregate / aggregation — n. 聚合体 / n. 聚集——近义真题另现

例句.英文: Rudolf Cesaretti et al. conducted an analysis of historical urban scaling trends circa 1300 CE in Western Europe, focusing on agglomeration patterns within medieval settlements.
例句.原书高亮: focusing on agglomeration patterns within medieval settlements
例句.中文: Rudolf Cesaretti 等人分析了公元1300年前后西欧历史上的城市规模变化趋势，重点关注中世纪聚落内部的集聚模式。

例句.英文: Although the clustering of cutlery manufacturing firms in Sheffield, UK, is often cited as typical of industrial agglomeration.
例句.中文: 尽管英国谢菲尔德餐具制造企业的聚集常被引为工业集聚的典型……

义项: 名词 聚集（体）；集合体（an aggregation of：一群…）
名词 汇总；加总（data aggregation 数据聚合）
搭配说明: aggregate — v./n./adj. 合计（的）
aggregator — n. 聚合器；整合平台

例句.英文: Among tree species in the Mo Singto plot (latitude 14.26°N) and other tropical forest sites, there is little correlation between conspecific aggregation and the abundance of a given species in the wider local area, so RSA is expected, but in the Smithsonian Conservation Biology Institute (latitude 38.89°N) and other temperate forest sites, the aggregation-abundance correlation for tree species is strongly negative.
例句.中文: 在 Mo Singto 样地（纬度 14.26°N）及其他热带森林样地，树种的同种聚集度与该物种在更大局域范围内的丰盛度几乎没有相关性；而在史密森尼保护生物学研究所（纬度 38.89°N）及其他温带森林样地，树种的聚集—丰盛度相关性则呈强负值。

义项: 动词 暗指；影射（allude to：间接提及，不点名）
动词 allude（暗指）≠ elude（逃避；使记不起）≠ refer to（直接指称）
搭配说明: allusion — n. 典故；暗指（真题高频文学术语）
allusive — adj. 含典故的；爱用暗示的

例句.英文: Amos Barton.” In the text, the narrator addresses the reader directly and alludes to a discussion among Rev.
例句.中文: 因此，乔治·英尼斯1855年在画作《拉卡瓦纳山谷》中把铁路置于前景的做法就格外引人注目——铁路图像在当时常常影射以进步之名对荒野的破坏。

例句.英文: For example, the Puerto Rican municipality of Corozal has also been called “the Cradle of Volleyball,” a nickname that alludes to what the area is well known for: being a longtime volleyball powerhouse.
例句.中文: 再如，波多黎各的科罗萨尔市也被称为「排球摇篮」——这个别名的所指正是该地为人熟知之处：长盛不衰的排球重镇。

义项: 名词 不同成分融合而成的整体（an amalgam of A with B）
名词 (引申义) 专指汞齐（牙科填充合金）；真题用来定义 creole 语言的「词汇供给语 + 底层语」结构

例句.英文: A creole language is an amalgam of a lexifier, or primary contributor of grammar and vocabulary, with one or more substrates, or secondary contributors.
例句.原书高亮: is an amalgam of a lexifier,
例句.中文: 克里奥尔语是「词汇供给语」（语法与词汇的主要来源）与一个或多个「底层语」（次要来源）融合而成的混合体。

义项: 名词 咏叹调（歌剧中的独唱曲）
[辨析] aria（独唱咏叹调）≠ recitative（宣叙调）≠ arioso（咏叙调）
搭配说明: opera / libretto — n. 歌剧 / n. 歌剧脚本——真题同域词
aria ≠ area — 形近异义，仅差一个字母

例句.英文: They omitted parts, such as the aria “I Got Plenty of Nuthin'," and sometimes made only brief gestures toward Gershwin's melodies.
例句.原书高亮: omitted parts, such as the aria
例句.中文: 他们删掉了部分内容，比如那首咏叹调《我一无所有也有余》，有时只是对格什温的旋律略作示意。

义项: 形容词 反常的、异常的：偏离常规、不符合预期模式
[构词] a-（无、偏离）+ nomal（= normal 规则）+ -ous →「不合规则的」
搭配说明: anomaly — n. 反常、异常（2072 卷真题：neoclassical economics cannot explain anomalies「无法解释这些反常现象」）
anomalies — n. 反常现象（复数）
anomalously — adv. 反常地

例句.英文: In her 2012 analysis of tree rings from Japan's Yaku Island, cosmic ray physicist Fusa Miyake noted an anomalous carbon-14 spike dating to 774-775 CE, indicating that a massive burst of radiation reached Earth during that time.
例句.中文: 在 2012 年对日本屋久岛树轮的分析中，宇宙射线物理学家三宅真观测到一次反常的碳-14 峰值，其年代可追溯至公元 774–775 年，表明当时有一场巨大的辐射暴抵达地球。

例句.英文: No other known heating mechanism on Jupiter could account for the formation of this anomalous structure, so one hypothesis considered was that it was ejected from the auroral region toward the equator.
例句.中文: 木星上没有其他已知的加热机制能解释这一反常结构的形成，因此有一种假说认为它是从极光区被抛射到赤道地区的。

义项: 动词 上升；攀登（ascend the throne：登上王位）

例句.中文: 接着波士顿倾斜着远去，他们毫不费力地升上黑沉沉的大西洋上空。

例句.英文: This work of public art depicts a staircase that appears to ascend into the clouds.
例句.中文: 这件公共艺术作品描绘了一道仿佛直上云霄的阶梯。

义项: 动词 使大吃一惊（be astounded by）
[构词] astounding adj. 令人惊骇的；语气强于 surprise，接近 stagger

例句.英文: He was the astounding, inconceivable growth of his locality.
例句.中文: 他本身就是那片乡土令人惊愕、难以想象的生长。

义项: 动词 增强；扩大；补充（augment A with B：用 B 来扩充 A）

例句.中文: 亚当正在港口与叔祖父理查德会面。这场开局如此顺利的会面，此后也进行得颇为融洽。

例句.中文: 阿尔·布莱克的《白鹭落日回水景》以苔树剪影映衬鲜亮的橙红天幕，是「佛罗里达公路客」画派的典型作品——这群联系松散的画家主要活跃于 1950 至 60 年代的佛州皮尔斯堡。

marketplace / souk — n. 市场 / n.（阿拉伯）露天市场

义项: 名词 瓶颈；阻碍进展的环节（create / present a bottleneck）
名词 （种群）瓶颈效应——演化生物学义
搭配说明: bottleneck ≠ backlog — 后者是「积压（的工作）」
constraint / impediment — n. 制约 / n. 阻碍——近义

例句.英文: Although efficiencies in long-distance transport of parcels have greatly improved delivery times, last-mile logistics (the final step in delivery to consumers) present a bottleneck for delivery companies.
例句.原书高亮: present a bottleneck for delivery companies
例句.中文: 尽管长途包裹运输的效率提升大幅缩短了配送时间，但最后一公里物流（送达消费者的最后环节）仍给快递公司造成了瓶颈。

例句.英文: Delivery companies are contending with the increasing popularity of next-day delivery and with the increasing volume of parcels to be delivered, resulting in a growing bottleneck of packages in the last-mile delivery stage.
例句.中文: 快递公司正疲于应对「次日达」日益流行的趋势与不断增长的包裹量，导致末端配送环节的包裹积压（瓶颈）日益加剧。

义项: 名词 悬钩子属多刺灌木；arctic bramble 北极悬钩子
名词 (引申义) （英式）荆棘丛；brambly adj. 多刺的，也用来形容味道带野果的涩感

例句.英文: Soil thawing in Alaska has been accelerating as a result of climate changes, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO₂) absorption through greater productivity of arctic bramble (Rubus arcticus) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO₂ output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO₂ generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).
例句.中文: 阿拉斯加的冻土融化因气候变化而加速，一方面可能通过北极悬钩子等植被生产力提升而增加二氧化碳吸收，另一方面也可能通过土壤微生物活动产生的异养呼吸增加二氧化碳排放。

义项: 名词 短而硬的毛 / 刷毛；bristle-like structures 刚毛状结构
动词 bristle at 因不满而毛发倒竖、恼怒；（某物）密布着…bristle with

例句.英文: Like all species of baleen whales, the common minke whale feeds on tiny creatures known as krill by filtering water through bristle like keratin structures called baleen plates.
例句.原书高亮: water through bristle like keratin structures
例句.中文: 与所有须鲸一样，普通小须鲸以磷虾等微小生物为食：靠名叫「鲸须板」的、由角蛋白构成的刚毛状结构过滤海水。

例句.英文: Permafrost in Alaska has been degrading, potentially enabling increased carbon dioxide (CO2) absorption through greater productivity of bristle-pointed iris (Iris setoso) plants and other vegetation, but also potentially enabling increased CO2 output through greater heterotrophic respiration (CO2 generated by the activity of soil microorganisms).
例句.中文: 阿拉斯加的永久冻土一直在退化，这可能通过毛鸢尾等植被更高的生产力增加二氧化碳吸收，也可能通过更强的异养呼吸（土壤微生物活动产生的 CO₂）增加二氧化碳排放。

义项: 形容词 （态度、言辞）生硬无礼、不耐烦的
[辨析] 比 blunt 更带「不给人留余地」的粗率感；n. brusqueness

例句.英文: There is no denying that, since he was rather brusque in his ways, he never spared the young authors who asked his advice and read him their productions, but criticized vigorously, even to the verge of insult.
例句.原书高亮: was rather brusque in his ways,
例句.中文: 无可否认，由于他行事相当生硬，前来讨教、把习作念给他听的年轻作者从不被他留情，反而会被严厉批评，几近羞辱。

义项: 名词 迅速；敏捷（move with celerity）——文学 / 正式语体
[辨析] celerity「动作之快」≠ velocity「物理速度」≠ alacrity「乐意之快」
搭配说明: celerity ≠ celebrity — 形近异义：后者是「名人」
accelerate — v. 加速——同根 celer-（快）

例句.英文: … he merely moved with a light-poised and watchful celerity, weaving among the calico rushes of the animals …
例句.中文: 他并不是在奔跑，只是以一种轻盈、警觉而迅捷的姿态移动，在牲畜斑驳的涌动中穿行，像拳击手一样虚晃闪避，直到走到栅栏门边，穿过院子。

义项: 形容词 又潮又凉、黏腻不适的（clammy hands / a clammy morning）
形容词 真题 wet lay clammy 是狄更斯式倒装，写潮湿清晨栏杆门扉上那层黏冷的水气

例句.英文: On every rail and gate, wet lay clammy, and the marsh mist was so thick, that the wooden finger on the post directing people to our village--a direction which they never accepted, for they never came there--was invisible to me until I was quite close under it.
例句.中文: 每一道栏杆、每一扇门上，湿气都黏冷地凝着；沼雾浓得让路牌上指向我们村子的木指（那方向人们从不理会，因为他们从没来过）直到我走到跟前才看得见。

义项: 名词 排外的小集团、派系（the clique of the cultivated and learned）
[辨析] 带贬义，区别于中性的 group / circle；cliquish adj. 排他成性的

例句.英文: … to make it efficient outside the clique of the cultivated and learned, yet still remaining the best knowledge and thought of the time …
例句.原书高亮: outside the clique of the cultivated
例句.中文: 文化伟人热衷于传播：把时代最好的知识与思想从社会的一端送到另一端；他们努力剥去知识身上生硬、粗鄙、艰深、抽象、专业化、排他的一切，使它人文化，使它能在有学养者的小圈子之外同样生效，却仍不失为时代最好的知识与思想，并因此成为「甜美与光明」的真正源泉。

义项: 名词 cobble / cobblestone 圆润的铺路卵石
动词 cobble together 草草拼凑；真题 beach cobbles 指海滩卵石，是石器原料

例句.英文: Nearly all implements were fashioned from limestone—mostly from beach cobbles—rather than superior chert or obsidian, and the assemblages predominantly comprise flakes produced through direct percussion, with negligible representation of cores, blades, or retouched tools.
例句.中文: 几乎所有器具都用石灰岩打制——大多取自海滩卵石——而非更优质的燧石或黑曜岩；这批器物组合以直接打击产生的石片为主，石核、石叶与修整工具极少。

义项: 名词 连贯（性）；一致（性）（narrative coherence / coherence of the discipline）
名词 相干性（coherence of light——波的特性的术语）
搭配说明: coherent / coherently — adj. 连贯的 / adv. 连贯地
cohesion — n. 凝聚力——真题另现，偏「黏合、团结」
incoherence — n. 不连贯——反义

例句.英文: Standardization of the meaning of culture is a worthwhile goal that would increase the coherence of the discipline.
例句.原书高亮: increase the coherence of the discipline
例句.中文: 把文化的含义加以标准化是一个值得追求的目标，它将提升这门学科的内部一致性。

例句.英文: For too long, scholars have focused on narrative fragmentation versus coherence, inhibiting inquiry into other points of stylistic correspondence among works that would enrich our understanding of the modernist canon.
例句.中文: 长期以来，学者们纠缠于「叙事的碎裂与连贯」之争，阻碍了对作品间其他风格对应点的探究——而这些对应点本可丰富我们对现代主义经典的理解。

义项: 名词 凝聚（力）；团结（group / social cohesion）
名词 内聚；附着（力）
搭配说明: cohesive — adj. 有凝聚力的
coherence — n. 连贯性——近义，但偏逻辑 / 结构上的前后一致
adhesion — n. 黏附——物理语境常与 cohesion 对照

例句.英文: However, it hasn’t been clear how to foster strong group cohesion to motivate prosocial behavior at a global level given that humans tend to align more locally, from family to nationality.
例句.中文: 然而，鉴于人类的认同往往更偏向本地层面——从家庭到民族国家——如何在全球层面培育强大的群体凝聚力以激发亲社会行为，一直不甚清楚。

例句.英文: The cohesion species concept, described in 1985 by Templeton, defines species in accordance with phenotypic cohesion.
例句.中文: 凝聚种概念由 Templeton 于 1985 年提出，依据表型凝聚来界定物种。

义项: 形容词 可想象的；可能的（every conceivable obstacle）
[构词] conceive + -able
搭配说明: inconceivable — adj. 不可想象的——反义
conceivably — adv. 可能地
conceivable ≠ conceivable of — 真题作 every conceivable obstacle 一切可想到的障碍
conceive — 同词根构词变体，真题出现 9 次；已并入本词条统一计数

例句.英文: It seemed as if nature had determined to throw every conceivable obstacle in the way of those who should seek to join the two great oceans of the world.
例句.中文: 大自然仿佛决心要给那些试图把世界两大洋连接起来的人，设置一切可以想见的障碍。

例句.英文: In recent years, architects have heightened their focus on developing eco-conscious and sustainable buildings, as exemplified by Wendy House, a structure conceived by Earthscape Studio.

义项: 动词 限制；把…局限于（be confined to：仅限于）
动词 禁闭；关押
搭配说明: confinement — n. 限制；监禁
confining forces — 约束力——真题天体物理搭配
confine ≠ define / refine — 形近异义

例句.英文: While contemporary rapid assessment techniques have advanced this process by allowing numerous candidates to be tested quickly, these methods remain confined to examining known substances.
例句.原书高亮: these methods remain confined to examining known substances
例句.中文: 尽管当代的快速评估技术通过允许快速测试大量候选物推进了这一过程，这些方法仍局限于检测已知物质。

例句.英文: Although these are impressive velocities, they are not sufficient to overcome the confining forces of the Sun’s gravity and magnetic field, so the material is pulled back down.
例句.中文: 尽管这些速度相当可观，却不足以挣脱太阳引力与磁场的束缚，物质因此被重新拉回。

义项: 名词 凝神静思、审度（ activism and contemplation 行动与沉思对举）
[构词] contemplate v. 凝视 / 考虑 → contemplation n.；与 meditation 相比更偏「对象化的观照」

例句.英文: Moreover, she seeks to cultivate a practice of “constant evolution” untethered from any prescriptive agenda, so that her art navigates a liminal space between tradition and autobiography, community and itinerancy, and activism and contemplation.
例句.中文: 此外，她试图养成一种不受任何规定性议程束缚的「持续演化」实践，让她的艺术游走于传统与自传、社群与漂泊、行动与沉思之间的阈限地带。

义项: 名词 contingent on / upon 视某条件是否成立而定
形容词 哲学：非必然发生，可能不如此（contingent truth 偶然真理）
名词 派出执行任务的一批人员；a contingent of troops

例句.英文: Using hydrogen produced with renewable energy (green hydrogen) can help reduce a country’s industrial carbon emissions, but scaling to meet growing demand is contingent on having sufficient space for renewable energy infrastructure.
例句.原书高亮: demand is contingent on having sufficient
例句.中文: 使用由可再生能源生产的氢气（绿氢）有助于降低一个国家的工业碳排放，但要扩大规模以满足不断增长的需求，则取决于是否有足够的空间来建设可再生能源基础设施。

例句.英文: A contingent on B immaterial to C uncharacteristic of D determinative of Can artificial intelligence (AI) truly capture human consciousness?

义项: 形容词 趋同的；汇合的（convergent evolution 趋同演化）
[构词] con-（共同）+ verge（倾向）+ -ent
搭配说明: converge / convergence — v. 汇聚 / n. 趋同——真题演化类高频
divergent — adj. 分歧的——反义，真题亦现

例句.英文: Protas and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution - a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages - can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages.
例句.中文: Protas 及其同事探讨了趋同演化——即同一性状在两个生殖隔离的谱系中各自独立演化出来的现象——如何可能源自两个谱系共有的遗传机制。

例句.英文: Alvarez and colleagues have explored how convergent evolution—a phenomenon that occurs when the same trait evolves independently in two reproductively separate lineages—can result from a genetic mechanism shared by both lineages.

义项: 形容词 轻易得来的、不费力的——常含贬义：得来太易，因而流于表面（facile splendours 轻易得来的华美）
形容词 (引申义) 轻率作出的、信口而来的（a facile assumption 想当然的假定）
[辨析] facile ≠ easy：easy 是中性的；facile 多带负面评价，暗示「省事所以不深刻」
搭配说明: facilitate — v. 促进、使便利——同源但语义已分化
facility — n. 设施；熟练

例句.英文: Its very situation—withdrawn a little behind the facile splendours of St. Pancras—implied a comment on the materialism of life.
例句.中文: 它（国王十字车站）所处的位置——稍稍退隐在圣潘克拉斯车站那轻易得来的华美之后——本身就含蓄地评论了生活的物质主义。

义项: 形容词 晶体的；结晶的（crystalline structure / arrangement）
形容词 (引申义) 清澈透明的（crystalline water）——文学描写
搭配说明: crystal / crystallization — n. 晶体 / n. 结晶
crystalline ≠ crystallized — 后者指「已结晶的；糖渍的」

例句.英文: Unlike ferritic stainless steel, austenitic stainless steel has a face-centered cubic crystalline structure held stable by the presence of nickel and nitrogen.
例句.中文: 与铁素体不锈钢不同，奥氏体不锈钢具有面心立方的晶体结构，靠镍和氮的存在保持稳定。

例句.英文: Most of the ice found on Earth is ice Ih, distinguished by a crystalline structure in which molecules form a hexagonal pattern.
例句.中文: 地球上大部分的冰是冰 Ih，其晶格结构的特征是分子呈六边形排列。

义项: 名词 分贝（声音强度单位，缩写 dB）
[构词] deci-（十分之一）+ bel（贝尔）
搭配说明: decibel level / in decibels — 真题固定搭配：以分贝计
amplitude / frequency — n. 振幅 / n. 频率——同域物理量

例句.英文: Maya Elena Ruiz and colleagues conducted a study comparing musicians and nonmusicians in the volume, measured in decibels (dB), that they preferred when listening to various audio recordings, including solo piano pieces, symphonic works, and ocean sounds.
例句.中文: Antonia Olivia Dolan 及其同事研究了参与者在聆听各类录音（包括重金属音乐、原声民谣和自然声音）时偏好的音量（以分贝 dB 计）。

义项: 动词 推断；演绎（deduce A from B）
[辨析] deduce（演绎，从一般到个别）≠ induce（归纳，从个别到一般）
搭配说明: deduction / deductive — n. 推论；演绎 / adj. 演绎的
infer — v. 推断——近义，真题亦现

例句.英文: In fact, art historian Nicolai Cikovsky Jr. argues that Inness glorifies the subject of the railroad by painting a scene that suggests hopefulness rather than devastation. Text 2It is impossible to deduce anything about George Inness’s attitude toward his subject in the painting The Lackawanna Valley, primarily because it is a commissioned work.
例句.原书高亮: It is impossible to deduce anything about
例句.中文: 要推断乔治·英尼斯在画作《拉卡瓦纳山谷》中对其描绘对象的态度是不可能的。

例句.英文: Agee recounts driving a car through an area of rural Alabama that he is unfamiliar with. On which road the woods might give way to any extension of farm country there was no deducing: for we were somewhere toward the middle of one of the wider gaps on the road map, and had seen nothing but woods, and infrequent woods farms, for a good while now.
例句.中文: Agee 讲述了自己开车穿行阿拉巴马乡村陌生地带的经历。这条路两旁的树林会在何处让位于农田的延伸，无从推断：我们正处在地图上一处较宽的空白地带的中段，好一阵子除了树林和零星的林间农场，什么也没见到。

义项: 动词 认为；视为（be deemed to be / deem it necessary）——正式语体
[辨析] deem 是「经判断而认定」，比 think / consider 更正式、更有权威色彩
搭配说明: deem ≠ deem it + adj. + to do — 真题常见句式：deem it necessary to…
deem ≠ doom — 形近异义：后者是「厄运；注定」

例句.英文: Even famed film editor Thelma Schoonmaker, winner of multiple BAFTAs and recipient of the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement in 2014, is constrained by the footage available to her and will, at times, knowingly include shots with what are often deemed continuity “errors,” as was the case in The Aviator (2004), which includes a scene depicting Howard Hughes and Faith Domergue sharing a chocolate sundae.
例句.中文: 连屡获英国电影学院奖、2014 年获威尼斯电影节终身成就金狮奖的著名剪辑师 Thelma Schoonmaker，也受限于手头可用的素材，有时会明知故用一些通常被视为穿帮「失误」的镜头——《飞行家》（2004）即有一幕呈现 Howard Hughes 与 Faith Domergue 共享巧克力圣代。

例句.英文: Jevons deems a "double coincidence of wants"—in other words, each trading party must want precisely what the other has.
例句.中文: 杰文斯认为需要「需求的双重巧合」——换言之，交易的每一方都恰好想要对方拥有的东西。

义项: 动词 确定…的边界、范围（delimit riddles 标出谜题的起止）
[构词] de- + limit → delimit；n. delimitation；与 define 相比更强调「画出物理 / 文本边界」

例句.英文: Moreover, the manuscript lacks any paratextual apparatus—titles, commentary, lists of solutions—to delimit riddles, and the appearance of a distinctive mark to signal the ends of some riddles may be an unreliable clue.
例句.原书高亮: of solutions—to delimit riddles, and the
例句.中文: 此外，这份手稿没有任何副文本装置——标题、评注、答案表——来划定各则谜语的边界；而用来标示某些谜语结尾的特殊记号，也未必是可靠的线索。

义项: 名词 （英式拼写，美式 demeanor）外显的态度、仪态与做派
名词 propriety of demeanour 举止得体；真题以 judgment and propriety of demeanour 写人物长于分寸

例句.英文: He had not the great talents of his younger brothers, but he exceeded them in judgment and propriety of demeanour; his fault, if he had one, was an over-attention to words instead of things; there was a thought too much finesse about him, and, as even his father sometimes told him, he was too fond of a compromise.
例句.中文: 他不及几位弟弟才华出众，却在判断力与举止得体上胜过他们；若说有什么缺点，便是过于留意字句而非事情本身，心思太绕，连父亲有时也说他太爱折中妥协。

义项: 名词 威慑物；起阻止作用的东西（a deterrent to / against）
形容词 deterrent 亦作 adj.：威慑性的（deterrent effect）
搭配说明: deter / deterrence — v. 阻止；威慑 / n. 威慑
repellent — n. 驱避剂——真题同域词（sonic bird repeller）

例句.英文: Noting which termites the spiders first looked at and which termites they ultimately targeted, the researchers concluded that contrasting markings were a deterrent.
例句.中文: 研究者记录了蜘蛛首先注视哪些白蚁、最终又锁定哪些白蚁，据此得出结论：反差鲜明的斑纹起到了威慑作用。

例句.英文: Aware of some practical limitations of reflective elements and other common deterrents, Qing Chen et al. investigated the utility of an inexpensive, easily installed sonic bird repeller in a pear orchard.
例句.中文: 意识到反光装置等常见驱鸟手段存在实际局限，Qing Chen 等人在一片梨园中研究了廉价且易于安装的声学驱鸟器的效果。

义项: 名词 正文之外的枝节、跑题段落（digressions on…）
[构词] digress v. 离题 → digression；真题用 do not just stretch out the book but muddy its reasoning 点明其危害

例句.英文: While the first book’s chapters all contribute to bolstering a clear, coherent argument about income inequality, the second book’s digressions on subjects such as the authorship of the Sanskrit text known as the Manusmriti do not just stretch out the book needlessly but also muddy its reasoning.
例句.原书高亮: second book’s digressions on subjects such
例句.中文: 第一本书各章都在合力支撑一个关于收入不平等的清晰连贯论点，第二本书却岔开去谈《摩奴法典》作者归属之类的题目，不只把书无谓地拉长，还把论证搅浑了。

义项: 名词 稀释；冲淡（dilution of pollutants）
名词 （股权）摊薄
搭配说明: dilute — v. 稀释 / adj. 稀释的
dilution ≠ delusion — 形近异义：后者是「错觉」

例句.英文: Vegetation has two primary mechanisms by which it reduces air pollution: deposition (absorption of pollutants) and, the more effective, dispersion (dilution of pollutants by ventilation).

义项: 动词 切开生物体以观察结构
动词 (引申义) （对文本、论证）层层剖析；真题 dissect, anatomise, and give names 与「只知其表、不解其因」对举

例句.英文: He might dissect, anatomise, and give names; but, not to speak of a final cause, causes in their secondary and tertiary grades were utterly unknown to him.
例句.中文: 他或许能解剖、能作细致分析、能一一命名；但且不说终极原因，就连第二层、第三层的原因，他也全然无知。
